parameters.jsCode: const now=Date.now();const retryMs=15*60*1000;const rows=$input.all().map(i=>i.json);const eligible=rows.filter(r=>{if(r.status==='pending')return true;if(r.status!=='processing')return false;const claimed=r.claimedAt?Date.parse(r.claimedAt):0;return !claimed||(now-claimed)>=retryMs;}).sort((a,b)=>String(a.createdAt||'').localeCompare(String(b.createdAt||'')));if(!eligible.length)return [];const row=eligible[0];let payload={};let validationError='';try{payload=JSON.parse(String(row.payloadJson||'{}'));if(!payload||Array.isArray(payload)||typeof payload!=='object')throw new Error('payload must be a JSON object');}catch(e){validationError='invalid payloadJson: '+String(e.message||e);}return [{json:{...row,payload,validationError}}];
